notes: One entry per round of the TA-indicator strategy study (src/ml/ta_strategy, docs/ta-strategy-600-ticks.md). A round is a grid: every timeframe x horizon x model is fitted once per walk-forward fold, and every trading rule is scored on those out-of-sample probabilities. After each round a review reads the landed tables and its recommendations become the next round's entry here.

1.title: Baseline: the full TA battery, made honest
1.hypothesis: With the conviction gate fitted on validation rows, next-open fills, roll back-adjustment and one cost basis, the TA battery's best configurations earn less than the 20-64 ticks per day logged in July, and far below 600.
